scope: One unit more or less of a named line when the cart has several lines, in building_cart, awaiting_payment and awaiting_final_confirm
baselineFindings: building_cart: «quita una de mora» / «quita una de lulo» were saved as a delivery address and jumped to checkout
awaiting_payment and awaiting_final_confirm: «quita una de mora» removed the whole «Jugo De Mora ×2» line
«una de mora menos» answered «No tenemos de mora menos»; «uno menos de mora» asked «¿De cuál plato o línea?» although it named the line
«quítale una hamburguesa», «otra hamburguesa más», «una hamburguesa más» opened a one-row list (and dropped the final step to building_cart)
«quita uno» with several lines silently reprinted the cart; «agrega otro» answered «No encontré ese producto»
«una arepa menos» (not in the order) answered «Por ahora no manejamos arepa menos»
fix: tryHandleSingleLineQuantityNudge now accepts an optional line reference: «quita/saca/quítale/resta/baja una (de) <ref>», «una (de) <ref> menos», «uno menos de <ref>», «agrega/pon/dame otro <ref>», «otra <ref> más». The reference matches dish lines (excluding «para …» add-on rows) by every word against the line name and option values, singular/plural tolerant. One match: ±1 unit; «quita» at ×1 removes that line (unless it is the only line, which keeps the batch 31 explanation). Several matches, or an unscoped «quita uno»/«agrega otro» with several lines: asks which line, listing candidates, no change. A removal naming a catalog product that is not in the order says so; an addition for a product not in the cart keeps the normal add route. Lines with per-unit add-ons tied to them keep existing routes. The reply labels the option when two lines share a product name; in the final step it re-shows the summary with «confirmar».
knownGaps: «agrega un jugo» in the final step opens the list in building_cart with checkout resume (existing design)
The «¿De cuál…?» question stores no pending selection; a bare follow-up («la de mora») goes through normal routing
